title: The Interview Ready Scorecard
promise: Answer 8 quick questions and find out if you're ready for your next interview.
intro: Takes about two minutes. You'll get your score straight away, with the one thing to work on next.
privacy: We'll email you your result and the occasional tip. Unsubscribe any time.

questions.q: How often do you practise answering interview questions out loud?
Do you have three stories ready about times you solved a problem at work?
When they ask what you're looking for, how clear is your answer?

answers.label: I make it up on the spot

questions.q: Do you research the company before the interview?

answers.label: I talk to someone who works there

questions.q: How do you answer 'what's your biggest weakness'?

answers.label: A real one, and what I'm doing about it

questions.q: Do you ask them questions at the end?
Do you follow up after an interview?
How many interviews have turned into offers in the last year?

results.headline: Starting out
results.text: You're going into interviews unprepared, and it shows. Start with one practice answer out loud every day this week.

results.headline: Getting close
results.text: You've got the basics. Your stories are what's holding you back.

results.headline: Interview ready
results.text: You're ready. The next step is getting the offer you actually want.
